text:
marco_sales: Quick ask — need a hosted API key for a week-long POC with AltoHealth. They require IP allowlist + scope limited to embeddings + chat_generation, keys to rotate every 24h, and audit logs exported. Who can provision and what's the flow?
eli: We can issue short-lived hosted POC keys. Two flavors: 1) single-use provisioning URL that mints a 24h token, 2) scheduled rotation (server-side) that replaces keys every 24h. Need org_id and allowed CIDRs. Also confirm whether they want KMS-backed keys + no console access.
marco_sales: Org ID AH-331. Allowed CIDRs: 52.12.0.0/16, 3.4.5.6/32. They explicitly want no Console or dashboard access, just API calls.
jane_security: @eli confirm: are keys KMS-wrapped and do tokens carry requester metadata for audits? Also need a revocation endpoint we can call as part of offboarding.
eli: Yes — keys are KMS-backed and we attach metadata (provisioned_by, sales_deal, poc_id). Revocation is immediate via DELETE /v1/poc-keys/:id (service account required). For rotation we can either push new key + revoke old or issue rotating alias.
eli: Quick example to create a hosted POC key (ops API):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/poc-keys
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer SVC-PROVISIONER-xxx'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"org_id":"AH-331","ttl":"24h","scopes":["chat","embeddings"],"allowed_cidrs":["52.12.0.0/16","3.4.5.6/32"],"no_console":true}'
```
samir: Will issuing these tokens incur extra charges during the POC? They asked about cost implications for heavy embedding usage.
eli: Hosted POC tokens consume standard hosted billing. We can apply trial credits up front; embedding-heavy workloads will draw down credits faster. Rotation itself is a tiny operational cost. If they move to Dedicated later, we'll provide a capacity quote.
marco_sales: AltoHealth also wants a self-service rotate option so their infra team can trigger rotation without contacting us. Can we hand them a one-time provisioning link that mints scoped keys?
eli: Yes — we can create a preapproved template and generate a one-time provisioning URL that mints tokens conforming to the template. Flow: create template -> create one-time URL -> customer clicks -> receives token. Template scoped and allowlisted.
infra-bot: create-template tpl-az1 {"scopes":["chat","embeddings"],"allowed_cidrs":["52.12.0.0/16","3.4.5.6/32"],"no_console":true} -> status: success (tpl-az1)
jane_security: Retention: AltoHealth requires 90 days of audit logs for the POC; will sigcompliance accept 90d? Also they want proof of key revocation on offboard.
eli: We keep full audit trails; default enterprise retention is 365d but we can set POC buckets to 90d. Revocation events are logged with timestamps and actor.
marco_sales: Can someone provision an initial demo key for tomorrow 10:00am PST and generate the provisioning URL I can share during the call? @eli @infra-bot
eli: I'll create the initial key now and tag it althealth-poc-demo-2026-03-22. TTL 24h. I'll post the one-time provisioning URL here.
infra-bot: Key created (id: poc-98765), tags: [althealth-poc-demo-2026-03-22], expires: 2026-03-23T10:00:00Z, revocation_endpoint: https://api.redwood.com/v1/poc-keys/poc-98765
infra-bot: Provisioning URL (one-time): https://auth.redwood.com/p/one-time/abc123 — NOTE: link expires on first use or in 24h, whichever comes first.
marco_sales: Perfect — sending this to AltoHealth. I'll include the short runbook: 1) use provisioning URL, 2) rotate every 24h (they can click a new one-time link we generate), 3) confirm IP allowlist, 4) we will export audit logs to their S3 (deliverable).
jane_security: Add me on the offboard checklist: confirm revoke + export logs snapshot.
eli: Will do. I'll also add service_account sales-poc-provisioner to the token metadata and enable SIEM export to their S3 bucket.
marco_sales: Thanks team. If anything blocks, ping me. :thumbsup:
